sources.quote: HD 19275, also named Shangcheng, is a single star in the northern constellation of Cassiopeia.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 2.2 solar radii and 2.13 solar masses (FLAME) and 8,935 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
